title: Current toolkit: support-restricted mass bound, mass from value bounds, locality, NC closure
statement: Notation: ℝ^m = Euclid m; 𝒟_k(ℝ^m) = GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid m)) k; 𝒟^k(ℝ^m) = TestFormOn univ k; |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α; M(T) = T.mass = T.massOn univ, M_W(T) = T.massOn W; spt = support; ∂ = boundary, ∂T(ω) = T(dω) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply; dω = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ k ω, whose underlying form is exteriorDerivative ω); ι(t,x) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1}; e₀ = EuclideanSpace.single 0 1; Jv = ι(0,v); S(X) = {ι(t,x) : t ∈ [0,1], x ∈ spt X}; F^#ω(x) = (ω(F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x); X is NC when spt X is compact, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ (= M(∂X) for degree ≥ 1, = 0 in degree 0). Assume (VO) for all P, n, U ⊆ ℝ^P, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0 and (REP) for all P, n, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for all open W ⊂⊂ U there are a measure μ and ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n with μ(Uᶜ) = 0, μ(K) < ∞ for compact K ⊆ U, M_W(T) = μ(W) for open W, ξ μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α, T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ for all ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U), and (if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U) μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0. Then for all N, k: (A0) if X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) has M(X) < ∞, ψ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N), c ∈ ℝ and |ψ(x)| ≤ c for every x ∈ spt X, then |X(ψ)| ≤ c·M(X).toReal; (MB) if T ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N), C ∈ ℝ and |T(ω)| ≤ C·c for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) and c ∈ ℝ with |ω(x)| ≤ c for all x, then M(T) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C; (LOC) if X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N), η, η' ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N), W is open, spt X ⊆ W and η = η' on W, then X(η) = X(η'); (NCD) if X, Y ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) are NC then spt(X − Y) ⊆ spt X ∪ spt Y, spt(X − Y) is compact, M(X − Y) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn (X − Y) univ < ∞; (NCB) if X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N) has compact support and M(∂X) < ∞ then spt ∂X ⊆ spt X, spt ∂X is compact and boundaryMassOn ∂X univ < ∞.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → T.massOn W < ∞) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = μ W) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) ∧ ((∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → boundaryMassOn T W < ∞) → ∀ E : Set (Euclid P), μHE[n] E = 0 → μ E = 0)) → (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (c : ℝ), X.mass < ∞ → (∀ x ∈ X.support, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → |X ψ| ≤ c * X.mass.toReal) ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (C : ℝ), (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (c : ℝ), (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c) → |T ω| ≤ C * c) → T.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C) ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (η η' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (W : Set (Euclid N)), IsOpen W → X.support ⊆ W → (∀ x ∈ W, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x = (η' : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) → X η = X η') ∧ (∀ (N k : ℕ) (X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k), IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ → IsCompact Y.support → Y.mass < ∞ → boundaryMassOn Y univ < ∞ → (X - Y).support ⊆ X.support ∪ Y.support ∧ IsCompact (X - Y).support ∧ (X - Y).mass < ∞ ∧ boundaryMassOn (X - Y) univ < ∞) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)), IsCompact X.support → X.boundary.mass < ∞ → X.boundary.support ⊆ X.support ∧ IsCompact X.boundary.support ∧ boundaryMassOn X.boundary univ < ∞
